core.reactions.label: Reactions
core.reactions.other_help: Type or paste any emoji (Windows: Win + . , macOS: Ctrl + Cmd + Space).
core.reactions.kind_help: When someone reacts to my pages, categories or comments (off by default)
notify.reaction_help: When someone reacts to my pages, categories or comments (off by default)
core.reactions.admin_help: Any emoji can be used for reactions. Blocked emojis cannot be chosen any more, existing reactions with them are hidden. A blocked emoji is blocked in all skin tones.
perm.core.reactions.use_help: Add and remove own reactions on pages, categories and comments one may see.
perm.core.reactions.manage_help: Block emojis and remove reactions of others.
limit.core.reactions.per_person.help: How many different emojis one person may put on one page, category or comment.
